Emmy Awards 2026 Nominations Announced

The 78th Emmy Awards nominations have been announced, with 'The Pitt' and 'Hacks' leading the pack. The nominations were announced by the Academy of Television Arts & Sciences. This year's ceremony will be hosted by Mariska Hargitay on September 14.
